title: Desktop window: enroll, authenticator setup, sign in, room list, feed and composer
spec: An egui Window with four screens (Enroll, Authenticator, SignIn, Chat) and no I/O: the app applies Updates and drains Actions. Secrets typed into forms are Zeroizing, moved into the one Action that needs them, cleared from the form, and never shown by Debug (nor the authenticator secret in Update). Chat draws the app bar (server, total unread, Sign out), the room list (ui-model RoomList; opening a room emits Command::Sync), the feed (feed_rows, message HTML shown as plain text, edited and pending states) and the composer (ui-model Composer; Send or Ctrl+Enter emits Command::Post). egui's default_fonts stay off; Inter (OFL-1.1) is the only font.
